The test lists of the engine's rules target, `jackioh-cards`' lib and its `cards` test are the same before and after. The four server copies stay (see Open questions).

Found while planning: 6 of the 17 engine `fn must` are a different helper, a wrapper that reduces an action and panics on a refusal: `must(state, player_id, body)`. They are in `announce.rs`, `feng_shui.rs`, `immutable.rs`, `play_counts.rs`, `play_step3.rs` and `targeting.rs`. The scan (`shared_helper_definitions`) flags any `fn must(` or `fn must<`, so these six are renamed to `reduce_ok`. Their calls change name only; no argument changes.
